subject.title: fix: preserve OpenAI Responses message boundaries

question: Which proven lineage signal should distinguish cumulative provider snapshots from genuinely separate prefix-related Responses messages without dropping the shipped distinct-ID compatibility path?
rationale: The branch's same-ID rule is unsafe for the shipped provider stream, while the available evidence does not establish a replacement discriminator that automation can select confidently.

options.title: Use a proven provider-aware discriminator
options.body: Preserve distinct-ID snapshot collapse only for a provider-owned compatibility marker or wire pattern demonstrated by captured affected streams.

options.title: Accept same-ID-only collapse
options.body: Narrow the compatibility rule and knowingly risk restoring duplicate replies for providers that emit each cumulative snapshot as a new item.

options.title: Pause for captured stream evidence
options.body: Hold this PR until redacted real provider events establish a safe generic lineage rule.

recommendation.title: Use a proven provider-aware discriminator
recommendation.body: Preserve distinct-ID snapshot collapse only for a provider-owned compatibility marker or wire pattern demonstrated by captured affected streams.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and validated the shipped compatibility behavior that this decision must preserve or intentionally replace.
